# Examples: Relative Path

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Examples: Relative Path

As mentioned earlier, a relative path can change depending on where the current page is located.

Suppose we have a directory structure like this

![A directory structure of Programiz](data:image/png;base64,)

And, we want to link to the master-python.html resource.

Example 1

If the current page is https://programiz.pro/learn/master-java.html, the relative path becomes

```html
1<a href="master-python.html" target = "_blank">Python Course</a>
```

![An example showing redirection of relative URL.](data:image/png;base64,)

Example 2

If the current path is https://programiz.pro/index.html, the relative path becomes

```html
1<a href="learn/master-python.html" target = "_blank">Python Course</a>
```

![An example showing redirection of relative URL.](data:image/png;base64,)

Example 3

If the current page is https://programiz.pro/about/team.html, the relative path becomes

```html
1<a href="../learn/master-python.html" target = "_blank">Python Course</a>
```

Here, .. in the path is used to navigate one level up in the directory.

![An example showing redirection of relative URL.](data:image/png;base64,)

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
